mapper.select: SELECT pc.id AS collectionId , pc.name AS name , COUNT(pci.id) AS placeCount , CASE WHEN #{placeId} IS NOT NULL AND SUM(CASE WHEN pci.place_id = #{placeId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS saved , pc.created_at AS createdAt , pc.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM place_collection pc LEFT JOIN place_collection_item pci ON pc.id = pci.collection_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND pc.useremail = #{useremail} GROUP BY pc.id , pc.name , pc.created_at , pc.updated_at ORDER BY pc.updated_at DESC , pc.created_at DESC

SELECT pc.id AS collectionId , pc.name AS name , COUNT(pci.id) AS placeCount , FALSE AS saved , pc.created_at AS createdAt , pc.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM place_collection pc LEFT JOIN place_collection_item pci ON pc.id = pci.collection_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND pc.useremail = #{useremail} AND pc.id = #{collectionId} GROUP BY pc.id , pc.name , pc.created_at , pc.updated_at

SELECT pci.id AS collectionItemId , pci.collection_id AS collectionId , pci.place_id AS placeId , p.place_name AS placeName , p.category AS category , p.address AS address , p.road_address AS roadAddress , pi.file_path AS thumbnail , rs.rating AS rating , rs.reviewCount AS reviewCount , pci.created_at AS savedAt FROM place_collection_item pci LEFT JOIN place_collection pc ON pci.collection_id = pc.id LEFT JOIN place p ON pci.place_id = p.place_id LEFT JOIN place_image pi ON p.place_id = pi.place_id AND pi.sort_order = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pr.place_id AS placeId , ROUND(AVG(pr.rating), 1) AS rating , COUNT(*) AS reviewCount FROM place_review pr GROUP BY pr.place_id ) rs ON p.place_id = rs.placeId WHERE 1 = 1 AND pc.useremail = #{useremail} AND pc.id = #{collectionId} ORDER BY pci.created_at DESC
